title: 菊花賞の後に・虚ろなる焔

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite being ill-suited to the distance, Yaeno Muteki wins the Kikuka Sho with ease. Judging by her expression, however, she isn't that happy about it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She laments her performance and deems it a disgrace. She couldn't light the competitive fire inside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I point out that it might have something to do with Mejiro Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O's absence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Back at the Japanese Derby, she stoked her competitive spirit to a raging inferno to defeat them. But her desire to win today just can't compare to the obsession she held back then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Obsession… it becomes clear that is what Yaeno Muteki needs in order to improve. For now, we decide to continue training as we have been to prepare for our next goal, the Osaka Hai.
